overview: Build a small sci‑fi ground drone / rover: a chunky armored body on the left with a short connector arm leading to a small cylindrical “sensor pod” assembly on the right, matching the reference silhouette.

subassemblies.name: Main body block (armored hull)
subassemblies.description: A compact rectangular brick-built hull with a studded top surface (to match the large stepped block). Keep it mostly light/dark bluish gray, with layered plates to create the slight height change/step seen on top.
subassemblies.image_location: Left side; the largest gray block with many studs on top.

subassemblies.name: Rear/side extension (mounting ledge)
subassemblies.description: A smaller rectangular protrusion that bridges the hull to the articulated/sensor section. Build as a 1–2 stud wide ledge that sits slightly lower than the hull top, creating the ‘step’ profile.
subassemblies.image_location: Just right of the main body; the smaller gray block attached to it.

subassemblies.name: Connector arm (articulated linkage)
subassemblies.description: A short chain of 1x1 round elements and small plates to create a segmented arm. Use alternating round plates/tiles and 1x1 round bricks to echo the bead-like spacing in the reference.
subassemblies.image_location: Middle-right; the line of small round gray pieces between the extension block and the black cylinders.

subassemblies.name: Twin cylinders (equipment/tanks)
subassemblies.description: Two black 1x1 round bricks as paired ‘tanks’ or ‘thrusters’ mounted along the connector arm. Cap/space them with round plates to match the stacked look.
subassemblies.image_location: Right of center; the two black vertical cylinders.

subassemblies.name: Sensor head / camera pod
subassemblies.description: A small black head unit with a side-facing round detail (use a 1x1 brick with stud on the side or similar) to read as a camera/sensor. Attach to the end of the arm and add a small top plate for the compact blocky finish.
subassemblies.image_location: Far right end; the black block with a circular side detail.

subassemblies.name: Underside skids / feet (optional but buildable)
subassemblies.description: Add low-profile plates/tiles under the main body to stabilize it and give it a ‘hover skid’ or ‘crawler’ stance without changing the top silhouette.
subassemblies.image_location: Under the left body block (not prominent in the reference but supports display stability).

notes: Color-match the reference primarily with light/dark bluish gray for the hull and black for the cylinders/head; small gray round parts form the arm segments.
Keep the arm connection simple (stud-to-stud) so it stays sturdy; treat it as a rigid segmented boom rather than fully poseable.
If you want extra interest while staying on-model, add 1–2 small colored ‘status lights’ (trans-yellow/trans-red) on the hull sides without changing the overall shape.
